batch_policy: Exactly the next twenty fixed source IDs. Atomic per-source working checkpoint; immutable compressed batch deltas; verify exports before starting the next batch. No model fitting.
cutoff: Only confirmed history heights strictly below the reference-payment block; same-block/future excluded by unchanged extractor.
evaluation: Collection only. Audit attrition by membership and block before exploratory grouped fitting; no theft/device performance claim.
failure_policy: Keep error/incomplete results and null features, with no replacements or automatic retries. Durable attempt markers consume interrupted started attempts; raw orphans can be re-extracted offline.
provider_denial_policy: Stop with remaining sources pending if an entire batch returns HTTP 403/429.
publication: Hashed source IDs, normalized prior-block evidence, raw fingerprints, immutable batch deltas and complete/error/incomplete/pending rows; raw address plans/histories remain local.
requirement: Collect histories and unchanged strictly prior-block features for the fixed 1000 comparison sources; preserve attrition.
target: Operational known_coldcard_core_membership=0 only; compromise and hardware stay unknown.
unit: One fixed comparison input source address, with its frozen reference transaction/block.
